propositions: The fixture equivalence test required raw build_ticket_position_commit_map to return a complete map on first attempt, but the function explicitly contracts to return {} on Git transient failures (rc!=0, empty output, exceptions), and production code relies on per-event fallback.

Runtime injection of rc 128/empty, rc 0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) each reproduced the organic CI failure sequence: first batched call returned {}, identical immediate replay succeeded with all 8 entries against unchanged repository state.

Deleting the previously implicated loose blob (66842fd006b2fdc95ff55a33a263f1cb216bc7d6) left both broad and narrow git-log reads healthy, refuting the prior ENOENT mechanism as cause of the Gerrit 1827 recurrence.

Test-only fixture helper _fixture_batched_map was added to perform at most five exact resolver attempts with bounded recovery, returning on first complete map and raising diagnostics (fsck, count-objects) on persistent failure, without changing production authorship source or fallback semantics.

The four behavioral RED/GREEN mutation test cases (rc128/empty, rc0/empty, EAGAIN, persistent timeout) each independently failed before the recovery seam was added and passed after, confirming the fixture defect.
